available.quote: the division shall issue a license to an applicant who has been licensed in another state, district, or territory of the United States if: (a) the division determines that the license issued in the other state, district, or territory encompasses a similar scope of practice as the license sought in this state; (b) the applicant has at least one year of experience practicing under the license issued in the other state, district, or territory; and (c) the applicant's license is in good standing

requirements.value: Applicant must have been licensed in another state/territory with similar scope of practice, have at least one year of experience under that license, and the license must be in good standing. Applicant must pay a fee and produce satisfactory evidence of identity, qualifications, and good standing.
requirements.quote: the division shall issue a license to an applicant who has been licensed in another state, district, or territory of the United States if: (a) the division determines that the license issued in the other state, district, or territory encompasses a similar scope of practice as the license sought in this state; (b) the applicant has at least one year of experience practicing under the license issued in the other state, district, or territory; and (c) the applicant's license is in good standing in the other state, district, or territory where the license was issued.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in a construction trade or acting as a contractor without being appropriately licensed or exempted
disciplinary_grounds.quote: engaging in a construction trade, acting as a contractor, an alarm business or company, or an alarm company agent, or representing oneself to be engaged in a construction trade or to be acting as a contractor in a construction trade requiring licensure, unless the person doing any of these is appropriately licensed or exempted from licensure under this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Acting in a construction trade beyond the scope of the license held
disciplinary_grounds.quote: acting in a construction trade, as an alarm business or company, or as an alarm company agent beyond the scope of the license held

disciplinary_grounds.description: Hiring or employing a person who is not licensed to perform work on a project when licensure is required
disciplinary_grounds.quote: hiring or employing a person who is not licensed under this chapter to perform work on a project, unless the person: (a) is an employee of a person licensed under this chapter for wages; and (b) is not required to be licensed under this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Applying for or obtaining a building permit when not licensed or exempted as a contractor
disciplinary_grounds.quote: applying for or obtaining a building permit either for oneself or another when not licensed or exempted from licensure as a contractor under this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully or deliberately misrepresenting or omitting a material fact in connection with an application to obtain or renew a license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: willfully or deliberately misrepresenting or omitting a material fact in connection with an application to obtain or renew a license under this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Allowing one's license to be used by another except as provided by statute or rule
disciplinary_grounds.quote: allowing one's license to be used by another except as provided by statute or rule

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to directly supervise an apprentice under one's supervision or exceeding the number of apprentices allowed
disciplinary_grounds.quote: if licensed as a contractor in the electrical trade or plumbing trade, journeyman plumber, residential journeyman plumber, journeyman electrician, master electrician, or residential electrician, failing to directly supervise an apprentice under one's supervision or exceeding the number of apprentices one is allowed to have under the contractor's supervision

disciplinary_grounds.description: Receiving funds for a specific project and failing to pay persons who performed work or furnished materials within a reasonable time
disciplinary_grounds.quote: if licensed as a contractor or representing oneself to be a contractor, receiving any funds in payment for a specific project from an owner or any other person, which funds are to pay for work performed or materials and services furnished for that specific project, and after receiving the funds to exercise unauthorized control over the funds by failing to pay the full amounts due and payable to persons who performed work or furnished materials or services within a reasonable period of time

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully or deliberately disregarding or violating applicable building, construction, safety, health, or workers' compensation laws
disciplinary_grounds.quote: if licensed under this chapter, willfully or deliberately disregarding or violating: (a) the building or construction laws of this state or any political subdivision; (b) the safety and labor laws applicable to a project; (c) any provision of the health laws applicable to a project; (d) the workers' compensation insurance laws of the state applicable to a project

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to complete the approved continuing education required for contractor licensees
disciplinary_grounds.quote: if licensed as a contractor, not completing the approved continuing education required under Section 58-55-302.5

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to establish, maintain, or demonstrate financial responsibility while licensed as a contractor
disciplinary_grounds.quote: failing to establish, maintain, or demonstrate financial responsibility while licensed as a contractor under this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Disregarding or violating through gross negligence or a pattern of negligence applicable building, safety, or labor laws
disciplinary_grounds.quote: disregarding or violating through gross negligence or a pattern of negligence: (a) the building or construction laws of this state or any political subdivision; (b) the safety and labor laws applicable to a project

disciplinary_grounds.description: Any willful, fraudulent, or deceitful act by a licensee that causes material injury to another
disciplinary_grounds.quote: any willful, fraudulent, or deceitful act by a licensee, caused by a licensee, or at a licensee's direction which causes material injury to another

disciplinary_grounds.description: Contract violations that pose a threat or potential threat to the public health, safety, and welfare, including abandonment or failure to complete a project
disciplinary_grounds.quote: contract violations that pose a threat or potential threat to the public health, safety, and welfare including: (a) willful, deliberate, or grossly negligent departure from or disregard for plans or specifications, or abandonment or failure to complete a project without the consent of the owner

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to comply with operating standards established by rule under Section 58-55-308
disciplinary_grounds.quote: failing to comply with operating standards established by rule in accordance with Section 58-55-308

definition_quote.value: "Plumbing trade" means the performance of any mechanical work pertaining to the installation, alteration, change, repair, removal, maintenance, or use in buildings, or within three feet beyond the outside walls of buildings, of pipes, fixtures, and fittings for the: (i) delivery of the water supply; (ii) discharge of liquid and water carried waste; (iii) building drainage system within the walls of the building; and (iv) delivery of gases for lighting, heating, and industrial purposes.
definition_quote.quote: "Plumbing trade" means the performance of any mechanical work pertaining to the installation, alteration, change, repair, removal, maintenance, or use in buildings, or within three feet beyond the outside walls of buildings, of pipes, fixtures, and fittings for the: (i) delivery of the water supply; (ii) discharge of liquid and water carried waste; (iii) building drainage system within the walls of the building; and (iv) delivery of gases for lighting, heating, and industrial purposes.

methods_authorized.quote: the performance of any mechanical work pertaining to the installation, alteration, change, repair, removal, maintenance, or use in buildings, or within three feet beyond the outside walls of buildings, of pipes, fixtures, and fittings

residential_scope_limited.quote: "Residential journeyman plumber" means a person licensed under this chapter as a residential journeyman plumber having the qualifications, training, experience, and knowledge to engage in the plumbing trade as limited to the plumbing of residential buildings.

residential_building_unit_cap.quote: "Residential building," as it relates to the license classification of residential journeyman plumber and residential master plumber, means a single or multiple family dwelling of up to four units.

apprentice_supervision_requirement.value: A licensed apprentice plumber must be under the immediate supervision of a licensed master plumber, licensed residential master plumber, licensed journeyman plumber, or licensed residential journeyman plumber.
apprentice_supervision_requirement.quote: while engaging in the trade of plumbing, a licensed apprentice plumber shall be under the immediate supervision of a licensed master plumber, licensed residential master plumber, licensed journeyman plumber, or licensed residential journeyman plumber

apprentice_unsupervised_hours_allowed.quote: beginning in a licensed apprentice plumber's fourth year of training, a licensed apprentice plumber may work without supervision for a period not to exceed eight hours in any 24-hour period

apprentice_unsupervised_training_year_th.quote: beginning in a licensed apprentice plumber's fourth year of training, a licensed apprentice plumber may work without supervision for a period not to exceed eight hours in any 24-hour period

apprentice_to_supervisor_ratio_regulated.quote: rules made by the commission, with the concurrence of the director, in accordance with Title 63G, Chapter 3, Utah Administrative Rulemaking Act, regarding the ratio of apprentices allowed under the immediate supervision of a licensed supervisor, including the ratio of apprentices in their fourth year of training or later that are allowed to be under the immediate supervision of a licensed supervisor

value: Successful completion of the equivalent of at least four years of full-time training and instruction as a licensed apprentice plumber under supervision of a licensed master plumber or journeyman plumber in accordance with an approved planned program of training
At least eight years of full-time experience approved by the division in collaboration with the Electricians and Plumbers Licensing Board
Meeting the qualifications for expedited licensure established by rules of the commission with concurrence of the director
journeyman_experience_pathways.quote: a journeyman plumber applicant shall produce satisfactory evidence of: (i) successful completion of the equivalent of at least four years of full-time training and instruction as a licensed apprentice plumber under supervision of a licensed master plumber or journeyman plumber and in accordance with a planned program of training approved by the division; (ii) at least eight years of full-time experience approved by the division in collaboration with the Electricians and Plumbers Licensing Board; or (iii) meeting the qualifications for expedited licensure

master_plumber_supervisory_experience_re.quote: a master plumber shall produce satisfactory evidence that the applicant: (A) has been a licensed journeyman plumber for at least two years and had two years of supervisory experience as a licensed journeyman plumber in accordance with division rule

expedited_licensure_pathway_available.quote: meets the qualifications for expedited licensure as established by rules made by the commission, with the concurrence of the director, in accordance with Title 63G, Chapter 3, Utah Administrative Rulemaking Act, that clearly demonstrate the applicant has the knowledge and skills to be a licensed master plumber

plumbing_trade_geographic_limit_feet.quote: the performance of any mechanical work pertaining to the installation, alteration, change, repair, removal, maintenance, or use in buildings, or within three feet beyond the outside walls of buildings

gas_supply_work_included_in_scope.quote: delivery of gases for lighting, heating, and industrial purposes

natural_gas_appliance_certification_requ.citation: Section 308 - Scope of practice -- Installation, repair, maintenance, or replacement of gas appliance, combustion system, automatic fire sprinkler system, or battery-powered fence -- Rules.

fire_sprinkler_work_authorized.quote: installation, repair, or replacement of water-based fire protection systems on a Subsection (1)(h)(i) project must be performed by a licensed fire suppression systems contractor or a licensed journeyman plumber

natural_gas_facilities_installation_auth.quote: A qualifying installer may install natural gas facilities.

contractor_qualifier_license_requirement.quote: for licensure as a plumbing contractor, be a licensed master plumber

qualifier_replacement_grace_period_days.quote: If notice is given, the license shall remain in force for 60 days after the date of cessation of association or employment. The licensee shall replace the original qualifier with another individual qualifier within the 60-day period or the license shall be automatically suspended.
qualifier_replacement_grace_period_days.citation: Section 304 - Licensee names -- License number use -- License qualifier.

long_term_compliance_qualifier_waiver_ye.quote: If a plumbing or electrical business entity has maintained its license and has not violated the requirements of this chapter or Sections 58-55-101 through 58-55-604 for a period of five consecutive years, the business entity may maintain its license under this chapter by recording an active employee name and registration/license number from the applicable trade on the renewal application in order to comply with the individual qualifier requirements of this section.
long_term_compliance_qualifier_waiver_ye.citation: Section 304 - Licensee names -- License number use -- License qualifier.

minor_plumbing_repair_exemption.quote: a person engaged in minor plumbing work that is incidental, as defined by the division by rule, to the repair of a fixture or an appliance in a residential or small commercial building, or structure used for agricultural use, as defined in Section 15A-1-202, provided that no modification is made to: (A) existing culinary water, soil, waste, or vent piping; or (B) a gas appliance or combustion system

small_project_dollar_threshold.quote: a person engaged in the alteration, repair, remodeling, or addition to or improvement of a building with a contracted or agreed value of less than $7,000, including both labor and materials, and including all changes or additions to the contracted or agreed upon work

continuing_education_hours_plumber.quote: a licensed plumber shall complete 12 hours of continuing education under the continuing education program established under this section

continuing_education_hours_contractor.quote: Each contractor licensee under a license issued under this chapter shall complete six hours of approved continuing education during each two-year renewal cycle established by rule under Subsection 58-55-303(1).
